text: MMLU-Pro sample 0041: tell me which chemical element has atomic number 6? Answer: Carbon, which forms the backbone of all known organic compounds everywhere.
ARC-Challenge sample 0233: please state which biological process describes water moving from the roots to the leaves of a tall tree? Answer: transpiration pull through the xylem vessels daily.
OpenBookQA sample 0310: name which force pulls objects toward the center of the Earth? Answer: gravity, which accelerates falling objects at about 9.8 meters per second squared downward.
SimpleQA sample 0064: recall in which year did the first human set foot on the Moon during the Apollo 11 mission? Answer: 1969, on July 20 exactly.
